files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- **Resend a signing invitation.** "Reenviar convite" on a pending request lists
  who is signing and sends a new invitation to the signer you pick, for when the
  original was lost or landed in spam. Earlier links keep working.
- A sequential envelope only offers the resend to the signer whose turn it is,
  and never to someone who has already signed.

### Changed

- SignDocs PHP SDK 2.3.
- The status panel for a file now lists only your own signature requests. On a
  shared file, colleagues' requests no longer appear there.

### Fixed

- Any logged-in account could read the status and signer count of signature
  requests on any file by asking for its file id, even without access to that
  file. No signing links or signer names were exposed.
